content: Customer Dhruv Kapoor expressed surprise and frustration upon learning his health policy (HP-123456) expired last month without receiving renewal notices. Agent Vikram Patel apologized, explaining an error with the email address on file, and sent a renewal quote and application form for the customer to sign and return by the end of the week to reinstate the policy.

action_items: Review the renewal quote and application form
Return the signed form by the end of the week to expedite reinstatement
